gloss: departure, setting out on a journey

definitions.gloss: departure, setting out on a journey
definitions.explanation: The act of departing on a journey or trip. Often carries a poetic or emotional nuance, suggesting a significant life transition or new beginning.

examples.japanese: {旅立|たびだ}ちの{日|ひ}が{来|き}た。
examples.english: The day of departure has come.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{旅立|たびだ}ちに{胸|むね}が{躍|おど}った。
examples.english: My heart raced at the new beginning.

examples.japanese: {卒業式|そつぎょうしき}は{生徒|せいと}たちにとって{新|あたら}たな{旅立|たびだ}ちの{始|はじ}まりだ。
examples.english: The graduation ceremony is the start of a new journey for the students.

notes:
USAGE:
Has a literary, poetic quality. Often used figuratively for life transitions such as graduation, starting a new career, or embarking on a new chapter. Also used as a euphemism for death ({最期|さいご}の{旅立|たびだ}ち). The verb form is {旅立|たびだ}つ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旅立|たびだ}ちの{日|ひ}: day of departure
- {新|あたら}しい{旅立|たびだ}ち: a new beginning/journey
- {旅立|たびだ}ちを{見送|みおく}る: to see someone off
- {人生|じんせい}の{旅立|たびだ}ち: a life journey

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出発|しゅっぱつ}: departure (practical, neutral)
- {門出|かどで}: setting out, new start (ceremonial)
